These amphibious beastmen reside mainly on the western coastline of the island of Elshimo, primitive fishers who rarely interact with other races except in war.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Sahagins gain +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Charisma.
  • Size: Sahagins are Medium creatures.
  • Type: Sahagins are Humanoids with the aquatic subtype.
  • Base Speed: Sahagins have a base speed of 30 feet and a 30 foot swim speed.
  • Languages: Sahagins begin play speaking Sahagin and Common.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Bond to the Depths: Sahagins gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC in shallows and deep water terrain.
  • Mist Child: Whenever a sahagin has concealment or total concealment, the miss chance of attacks against her increases by 5%.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Amphibious: Sahagins can breathe both in and out of the water.
  • Weapon Proficiency: Sahagins are always proficient with tridents.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Bite: Sahagins have a natural bite attack dealing 1d4 points of damage.
  • Claws: Sahagins have two claw attacks dealing 1d4 points of damage.
  • Water Gun: Once per day, sahagins can cast Water Gun using their Wisdom modifier for the saving throw and their level as caster level.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Sahagins can see twice as far as humes in dim light.
